dataformat.name: gzipDeflater
dataformat.title: GZip Deflater
dataformat.description: Compress and decompress messages using java.util.zip.GZIP*Stream
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: The data to compress: text in the charset of the exchange, bytes, a stream or a file

marshalOut.description: The gzip data, as in a .gz file, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: Gzip data, such as a .gz file; gzip members one after the other are read as one

unmarshalOut.description: The decompressed data in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off
